subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed as a union_id-based rewrite, switch to another proven cross-app identity strategy, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The submitted identity source is disputed, the branch conflicts with current main, and the fix changes message admission behavior where the wrong identity contract can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context while broader Feishu multi-bot identity work becomes the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close This Branch, Keep The Issue
options.body: If union_id remains unavailable, close this stale PR without merging and leave the linked issue as the tracking point for a new approach.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live changes-requested reviewer and have recent Feishu identity/message-path history.
